decisions.evidence: Definition: additivity is hom-group additivity, cocontinuity includes empty colimits and the zero functor. Fixed definable schemas and set component codes conform to def-functor-category and rem-category-theory-class-and-size-conventions; no collection of all class functors is formed. The reformulation has its exact justified_by link; its discharge remains assigned at level 1. Arbitrary unital rings and zero rings are admitted, with no choice.

Proof 1.1–3.1: r_a is left A-linear, r_(aa′)=r_a′ r_a, r_(a+a′)=r_a+r_a′ and r_1=1. F preserves composition and addition; its B-linear maps commute with B scalars. These give all right-module and commuting-action laws, including zero modules and zero rings. Dependencies def-bimodule, def-left-and-right-modules, def-additive-functor and def-functor-and-contravariant-functor were opened. Only contract boundaries changed; the item hashes agree pre/post.

Proof 1.1–3.1: tensor additivity follows on generators. The finite-support balanced inverse to the direct-sum comparison is well-defined and both composites are identities, including the empty sum. For a cokernel g, the lift formula is independent of its representative because v kills 1⊗f; this gives the cokernel UP and surjectivity. Only finitely many existential lifts are used for any tensor, with no global selection. Outer B-linearity follows on generators. Every cited tensor, direct-sum, exact-sequence, Hom/kernel and bimodule supplier was opened. Zero modules/rings produce the zero tensor; unchanged item hashes pre/post, amended contract boundaries are sound.

Proof 1.1–5.1: tensor-unit conjugation gives a B-linear f. Naturality at right multiplication implies f(ma)=f(m)a, and naturality at ell_x gives eta_X(m⊗x)=f(m)⊗x. Conversely bimodule maps induce natural B-linear components. The two assignments are inverse and preserve sums, identities and composition; elementary tensors generate. Unit, outer-action, tensor functoriality, bimodule, natural-transformation, vertical-composition and Hom suppliers were read. Zero cases are included, with no choice. Reader §Repairs 1 adds set-code wording consistently with the published ZFC convention; no algebraic claim is weakened.

Proof 1.1–3.1: identities, compositions and vertical transformations obey their laws componentwise. Coproduct preservation determines free-module components; the canonical free cover is epic and right exactness preserves it, so equal regular components give equal transformations. For fixed defining formulas, unique descents turn admissibility into a ZFC predicate over modules and maps; separation in Hom_B(F(A),G(A)) gives the set of codes. All 11 declared suppliers were read at their cited assertions, including the free-cover, epic-preservation and vertical-composition arguments. The zero-module cover is A→0 rather than an empty free module; zero rings and empty sums are harmless. No AC or class-valued replacement is used. Reader §Repairs 1 is accepted after this independent proof review.

Proof 1.1–3.1: all-small-colimit preservation implies preservation of cokernels, coproducts and finite colimits. Conversely the arrow/object coproduct construction and coequalizer=cokernel(d−c), with F(d−c)=F(d)−F(c), carry the actual colimit cocone to a colimit. Finite biproduct preservation plus cokernels handles finite colimits and the empty coproduct. All nine suppliers were opened; their exact smallness, additivity and abelian-category hypotheses hold. No choices, commutativity or nonzero-ring hypothesis is required. This discharges the definition characterization in both directions. Item bytes are unchanged pre/post; revised contract citation and boundary evidence is accepted as audit enrichment.

Verification 1.1–6.1 and Example: alpha maps the kernel tensor functor to the composite. Thus alpha′ inverse eta alpha has the correct domain and its inverse conjugation is alpha′ xi alpha inverse. The pair-induced component is (g⊗1_(M′⊗X))(1_N⊗(f⊗1_X)), which equals conjugation of ((g⊗f)⊗1_X) on elementary tensors. All thirteen cited suppliers were read; associativity preserves the outer actions and is natural. The dot-product map k²⊗k²→k has matrix entries delta_ij; the four scalar equations forbid any decomposable pair over every field, including characteristic two. Zero kernels and noncommutative rings fit the general classification; the witness uses a nonzero field, with no AC.

Proof 1.1–4.1: tau_A is the right tensor-unit map. Coproduct preservation identifies tau on free modules with the coproduct of tau_A. The canonical cover A^(|X|)→X and the cover of its kernel produce an exact presentation without choosing generators. Right exactness makes both images cokernels; the inverse free comparisons induce sigma_X, and cancellation at the cokernel maps proves both inverse identities. All eleven exact suppliers were read. At X=0 the cover is A→0, K=A and first free term A^(|A|), so the corrected boundaries agree with the proof. Empty free sums and zero rings are included. EGNO Proposition 1.8.10, printed p. 10, was read with its finite-dimensional k-linear hypotheses; it is a route analogue, not an arbitrary-ring supplier. F4 now describes induced B-linear maps with A-module arguments.

Proof 1.1–3.1 checks both directions: tensor additivity/right exactness/coproduct preservation implies cocontinuity by the already-reviewed characterization; an additive cocontinuous F has commuting evaluation action and an invertible canonical comparison by the already-reviewed presentation lemma. Tensor-unit reconstruction respects both bimodule actions. All nine prerequisites are current and independently reviewed. Functoriality on maps is the tensor-transformation theorem, and evaluation on transformations commutes with right multiplications; its schematic quasi-inverse is made explicit in the level-4 equivalence corollary. Empty coproducts, zero functors and either zero ring cause no exception. No arbitrary generator selection or AC occurs. Reader size qualification in Statement/F2 agrees with the published fixed-schema convention; arbitrary-ring representation remains intact. The contract incorrectly denied a converse despite Statement (ii); both iff boundary rows now record the exact proved directions.

Proof 1.1–3.1: take the reviewed canonical sigma:T_M→F and G=Hom_B(M,−). The transferred unit (G sigma) eta and counit epsilon (sigma inverse G) have the claimed types. Naturality at G(sigma_X), eta_X and sigma_X gives the first triangle; cancelling G(sigma inverse)G(sigma) gives the second. Thus F⊣G. All eight cited suppliers were opened, including the whiskering and adjunction definitions and the colimit-preservation argument. M=0 yields unit X→0 and counit 0→Y, with triangle identities at zero functor values. Arbitrary rings and no AC are preserved. Item bytes agree pre/post; only corrected contract inputs and boundaries changed.

Proof 1.1–3.1: tensor maps give a functorial schematic assignment; the reviewed transformation bijection supplies full faithfulness and canonical F(A) supplies a split representation. For eta:F→G, tau_G inverse eta tau_F is typed, hence gives the unique bimodule E(eta); tau_(F,A)=rho_(F(A)) identifies it with eta_A. Composition and the two natural comparison/unit isomorphisms give the explicit quasi-inverse without class-valued objects or choice. All eight prerequisites were read, including the split-equivalence construction rather than applying it blindly to a category of class objects. Naturality of the Hom bijection and both directions T_M≅T_M′ iff M≅M′ follow from compatibility with composition. Zero bimodules/rings produce singleton Hom codes, not literally identical one-object categories.

Counterexample 1.1–3.1: Hom_Z(Z/2,−) is additive and left exact by the read covariant Hom supplier. A map is determined by the 2-torsion element phi([1]); its finite support gives both injectivity and surjectivity of the coproduct comparison, including the empty sum. The quotient Z→Z/2 is epic but F sends it to 0→H with H nonzero. Distinct endomorphisms 1_H and 0_H have equal composites with that map, so it is not epic and F is not right exact. Tensor functors are right exact and the property transports through a natural isomorphism, so the claimed obstruction holds. All eleven dependencies were read at their exact used assertions. No AC occurs. Reader §Repairs 5 corrects the epicness test object's typing without changing the counterexample.

Counterexample 1.1–4.1: countable products are additive; for the kernel equation, preimages under the injection are unique and give a family without AC. Surjectivity uses the explicitly assumed countable instance of AC on fibres, so short sequences remain exact. The comparison image consists exactly of families supported in a common finite set J of summand indices: source support gives containment and coefficient extraction gives the converse. Scalar sequences themselves may have infinite support. The family (e_n) has no such J over any field, including characteristic two. Naturality conjugates coproduct comparisons, precluding tensor representation. All eight suppliers and the exact AC use were read; zero spaces and empty sums behave correctly. Reader §Repairs 4 repairs the false support computation.

Verification 1.1–4.1: the actual published extension definition and adjunction are for commutative unital ring maps, as explicitly retained in the Example. Tensor additivity and the adjunction give cocontinuity. Under rho_S(s⊗x)=s f(x), applying 1⊗r_a gives s f(xa)=s f(x)f(a), so evaluation recovers precisely the right R-action. The same formula works for arbitrary unital maps as a stated computation caveat, without inflating the published extension definition. All six exact suppliers were read; zero target ring, identity map and zero input module are included, with no AC. Item bytes agree pre/post; corrected contract anchors and quoted current suppliers are audit enrichment.

Proof 1.1–4.1: underlying abelian-group sequences detect B-module injectivity, surjectivity, kernels and images. Thus the already-additive T_M is exact iff its underlying tensor functor to Ab is exact; the published right-flat definition makes this exactly right A-flatness. Termwise isomorphisms preserve exactness, and the reviewed schematic equivalence gives both directions on isomorphism classes. All eleven prerequisites were read at their exact assertions. This asserts no left B-projectivity and forms no set of all isomorphism classes. The zero bimodule is flat and exact; either zero ring is harmless. No AC or commutativity is introduced. Reader Statement/F7 size qualification is accepted.
